notes.title: FUN_DA_MENTAL_PSYCHOSIS
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

I've been working on a new game however I've also learned a lot during the process that I want to update Epileptic Seizure Battle Ball Challenge to reflect this. I'm working on an update that will add more powers, enemies and enemy AI. A better UI with pictorial symbols instead of language. Game console controls as well as phone controls. Better sprites, better menu, more effects and physics. This update should be out soonish, hopefully in a couple of weeks. 

Thank you to everyone who has purchased my game and thank you for the feedback.

Have fun everyone!

Alchemicode
